source_refs.note: Topic 1.8.7 Online and Offline Computing Platforms (PDF 30, printed 27).

blocks.text: Computing platforms provide environments where developers can write, run and test their code.

blocks.caption: Online and offline platforms
rows: local development environment on a computer

blocks.prompt: What is the difference between an online and an offline computing platform?
blocks.explanation: An online platform runs in the cloud and is used through the internet (Repl.it, Gitpod); an offline platform is a development environment installed on your own computer.

items: Platforms: environments to write, run and test code; online (cloud: Repl.it, Gitpod) or offline (local IDEs).
